Vote by Nov 3, 2026
Dear Neighbors,
​
My family and I chose to make Millbrae our home because of its safe neighborhoods, excellent schools, and welcoming community.
​
As a father, supporter of local businesses, and first-generation immigrant, I'm running for City Council because I believe Millbrae’s future should be shaped by residents — not outside interests.
Read More
# Priorities
As your city councilmember, I will fight for:
## Local Control
Millbrae’s Future. Millbrae’s Voice.
Keep local decisions in local hands.
### Safer Streets, Stronger Community
Protect our neighborhoods and quality of life
### Infrastructure That Works
Fix our roads, ease traffic & parking congestion, and deliver projects that make a real difference for Millbrae residents.
### Fiscal Responsibility & Transparency
Spend wisely, streamline permitting, improve city services and keep Millbrae’s finances sustainable and transparent.

As an immigrant coming to the United States for education, I understand the importance of being prudent with budget and spending.
​
With a bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science from Purdue University and a master's degree in Technology Management from Columbia University, I have strong expertise in finance and data, an important facet that is missing in the current city council.
​
With your vote of confidence, I will bring my skillsets to serve the city we all love and be proud of.
Read More
